page_title: SUN 1-0 NEW | Sunderland v Newcastle 14/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+5' It must be a yellow card. It is. Malick Thiaw (Newcastle Utd) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
90+4' Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) has tested the patience of referee Peter Bankes and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+4' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) was quite harsh and Peter Bankes didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+4' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+3' The resulting corner from Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) comes to nothing.
90+2' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.

90' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sunderland.
88' Peter Bankes blows his whistle and it's Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
87' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
86' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.

84' The opposition can't get near Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the right post at the last second. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
83' A substitution has been made. Chemsdine Talbi is replaced by Romaine Mundle (Sunderland).
81' Newcastle are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
80' Yoane Wissa (Newcastle Utd) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
78' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
77' Newcastle are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
75' Substitution. Yoane Wissa (Newcastle Utd) in, Nick Woltemade out.
73' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Granit Xhaka (Sunderland), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

73' A great touch by Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) as he latches on to an excellent cross inside the box. He rips a snap shot close to the right post, but the goalkeeper reacts superbly to keep the ball out. World class save! The ball is out of play. Sunderland will have a chance to score from a corner.
70' Regis Le Bris has decided to substitute Bertrand Traore and he is replaced by Trai Hume (Sunderland).
70' Here comes a substitution. Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) is brought on as a substitute for Brian Brobbey.
70' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
69' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
67' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Robin Roefs has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
66' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) sends a cross into the box, but Robin Roefs comes off his line to gather the ball.
65' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Jacob Murphy, but Robin Roefs displays great awareness to stop him.

63' A neat pass is well received by Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
62' Newcastle keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sandro Tonali departs the field of play to be replaced by Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd).
59' Here is a change. Anthony Elanga is going off and Eddie Howe gives the last tactical orders to Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd).
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) comes onto the pitch so that Anthony Gordon can be given a rest.
58' Reinildo Mandava (Sunderland) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
57' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Peter Bankes had an easy-decision to make.
55' Malick Thiaw (Newcastle Utd) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
53' Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Sunderland.
51' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland).
49' The Newcastle players are exchanging some short passes.
46' 1 - 0 It's an own goal! An unlucky moment for Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but heads the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 1:0.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

45' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Daniel Ballard (Sunderland) who loops his header high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
43' Great teamplay by Sunderland as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
42' Eddie Howe is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) suffers an injury and Fabian Schar comes on.
40' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
38' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
36' Looks like Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
34' Peter Bankes shows a yellow card to Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) for his blatant foul.
34' Neat passing move from Newcastle in order to create new attacking opportunities.
31' Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

29' Wasted opportunity! Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
27' This is a yellow card! Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
27' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) commits a foul and Peter Bankes immediately signals a free kick.
25' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) swings in a cross from the corner, but Robin Roefs reads it well and gathers the ball.
24' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Newcastle will take a corner kick.
22' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
20' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
18' Omar Alderete (Sunderland) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is out of play. Newcastle will take a throw-in.
16' A pass from Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) is intercepted by Robin Roefs and the move breaks down.
14' The resulting corner from Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) is cleared by the defence.
14' Bertrand Traore (Sunderland) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Sunderland force their opponents to concede a corner.
12' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Sunderland will have a goal kick.
11' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Brian Brobbey (Sunderland), but Aaron Ramsdale is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.

10' A cross by Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is out of play. Newcastle will have a throw-in.
8' Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) plays a lovely through ball to Anthony Elanga, but he can't beat Robin Roefs and loses the ball.
8' A dangerous looking corner kick from Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) is cleared to safety by the defence.
6' Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
4' Sunderland seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Newcastle will have the kick-off.
Peter Bankes is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
